nodes.name: Conjecture 1.1
nodes.statement:
If $\hat H^{\geqslant 0}(G,M)$ is finitely generated as a module over $H^*(G,k)$ then
$M$ is cohomologically equivalent to a finitely generated $k G$-module.

nodes.name: Conjecture 1.3
nodes.statement:
If $X$ is in $\mathsf{KInj}^{\mathsf{b}}(k G)$ then $X$ is cohomologically equivalent to
an object in $\mathsf{D}^{\mathsf{b}}(k G)$.

nodes.name: Conjecture 1.5
nodes.statement:
If $Y$ is in $\mathsf{D}^{\mathsf{b}}(C^*BG)$ then there is an object $X$ in $\mathsf{D}^{\mathsf{b}}(k G)$
such that $Y$ is equivalent to $C^*(BG;X)$.

nodes.name: Conjecture 1.2
nodes.statement:
$\mathsf{StMod}^b(k G)$ is equal to the thick subcategory 
\[ \mathsf{Thick}(\mathsf{stmod}(kG),\mathsf{StMod}^0(k G)) \] 
of $\mathsf{StMod}(kG)$ generated by the finitely
generated modules and the no cohomology modules.

nodes.name: Conjecture 1.4
nodes.statement:
$\mathsf{KInj}^{\mathsf{b}}(k G)$ is equal to the thick subcategory 
\[ \mathsf{Thick}(\mathsf{D}^{\mathsf{b}}(k G),\mathsf{KInj}^0(k G)) \] 
of $\mathsf{KInj}(k G)$ generated
by the bounded derived category and the no cohomology objects.

nodes.name: Conjecture 1.6
nodes.statement:
$\mathsf{D}^{\mathsf{b}}(C^*BG)$ is generated as a thick subcategory of $\mathsf{D}(C^*BG)$ by the objects
$C^*(BG;X)$ for $X$ in $\mathsf{D}^{\mathsf{b}}(k G)$.

nodes.name: Conjecture 1.7
nodes.statement:
The bounded derived category $\mathsf{D}^{\mathsf{b}}(C^*BG)$ is generated by the
module $C^*BS$, where $S$ is a Sylow $p$-subgroup of $G$.
